title: ClinicalTrials.gov Scraper – Condition, Phase & Site Mode
description: Scrape ClinicalTrials.gov official NIH API: condition, intervention, sponsor, location, facility and lead-sponsor filters, plus six date windows. Optional one-row-per-site mode. No contact PII, ever. Optional watchLabel mode returns only studies new since your last run. $0.0015/result, no start fee.
